steps.question: TRAIL_PEAK_MODE close-vs-high (chong wick tren dinh trailing). Verify TRUOC khi chay: (1) JAR ${JAR} co doc env TRAIL_PEAK_MODE trong Configs (high=maxPrice=mac dinh=hanh vi cu byte-identical; close=priceClose). Chi doi diem ARM/RATCHET trailing, KHONG dung minPrice/MAE/disaster/time-stop. (2) JAR cung wire WFO_DISABLE_DCA + ABLATION_MODE + TIME_STOP_HOURS trong WfoWorker.main (da verify o ladder kill-test). (3) Dataset ${DS}=wfo_ds_ev2 (EV2 funding, symId gate-check PASS). (4) ABLATION_MODE=B = PASS het filter = entry thuan EV2 selector. (5) KAGGLE_KERNELS=0 vi Kaggle khong nhan extra_env. (6) Report high (kill-test cu) ${TAG_TR24_HIGH}/${TAG_TR72_HIGH} da ton tai de so sanh (neu chua -> chay ladder truoc). Da verify het -> 'yes ${JAR}'; chua -> 'stop'.

steps.cmd: R=${CE_RUN_DIR:-/home/ubuntu/claudedata/.run/mcp_ce}; { echo '=== HIGH nuoi24 (${TAG_TR24_HIGH}) ==='; grep -iE 'VERDICT|OOS|WFE|maxDD' "$R/wfo_report_${TAG_TR24_HIGH}.md"; echo; echo '=== CLOSE nuoi24 (${TAG_TR24_CLOSE}) ==='; grep -iE 'VERDICT|OOS|WFE|maxDD' "$R/wfo_report_${TAG_TR24_CLOSE}.md"; echo; echo '=== HIGH nuoi72 (${TAG_TR72_HIGH}) ==='; grep -iE 'VERDICT|OOS|WFE|maxDD' "$R/wfo_report_${TAG_TR72_HIGH}.md"; echo; echo '=== CLOSE nuoi72 (${TAG_TR72_CLOSE}) ==='; grep -iE 'VERDICT|OOS|WFE|maxDD' "$R/wfo_report_${TAG_TR72_CLOSE}.md"; } > "$R/ladder_peak_summary.txt"; cat "$R/ladder_peak_summary.txt"

steps.question: TRAIL_PEAK_MODE verdict: close (priceClose chong wick) vs high (maxPrice kill-test cu). So tr24_close vs tr24_high va tr72_close vs tr72_high tren OOS-duong% / WFE median / worst maxDD. Close co CAI THIEN (giam maxDD/it giat SL) ma KHONG hy sinh qua nhieu upside khong? Neu close >= high tren cac chi tieu chinh -> de xuat default close cho horizon tuong ung. Neu close kem hon -> giu high (mac dinh), close chi la option chong wick khi can.
